checks.topic: Private trust profile and allocation scope
checks.finding: The profile relies on kernel VM ownership of private backing inside inherited RAM plus known guards; it asserts neither global census nor DMA authority. Configuration does allocate native anchor/mutex controls through real IOMallocZero/IOLockAlloc. No backing descriptor acquisition or effect is performed.

Pure argument/overlap checks precede the CAS. One successful CAS enters READING; subsequent busy phases reject reentry and terminal CONFIGURED/FAILED reject reuse. No reset API exists. Independent simultaneous same-state calls using separate workspaces select exactly one reader/configurator.

All direct five object extents and declared context extent are bounded/disjoint before use. Expected identity and ops are copied and compared after callbacks. Accessible stable storage, protected resident code/context and serialized trusted callbacks remain prerequisites; this is not validation of hostile arbitrary function pointers.

Original aligned RAM intervals retain individual boundaries and holes. Full relevant intervals are rounded outward to 16KiB, sorted and merged only on overlap/adjacency within eight slots. Independent page-cell intersection oracle covers all 16384 offset residues and 4096 interval collections; PA36 endpoints refuse overflow atomically.

CONFIGURING is set before the actual configure call. Receipt consistency is a check of the fixed synchronous call, not detached authority. Public output commits last; error or inconsistency leaves it unchanged and permanently consumes the latch, with no rollback/free/retry. Independent after-configure inconsistency preserves output and blocks retry.

Fresh rerun of three independent TEST-SDK processes passes real reader/control/owner/core composition: known configuration, reserved-control mapping refusal and reader cleanup failure. Native global is never reset. Successful configuration allocates controls but no backing descriptor and has zero effects.

Reran four groups, 93 synthetic cases per ASan/UBSan host and KERNEL-defined host mode, plus 17 compiled assertion-killed mutants. Independent ASan/UBSan harness passes 20610 cases. Mutant compilation/refusal tests are distinct from semantic assertion kills.

Independently checked all 20 object hashes plus two ARM64 MH_OBJECT links, 36 source snapshots and 308 dependencies per mode. Fresh nm/disassembly verifies 21 external imports, no internal or atomic-runtime unresolveds, actual ldaxr/stlxr/stlr, all exports and exact 58da definitions. Saved genuine compile commands use real headers and no TEST SDK. No target build rerun or target execution claimed.
